sector.measure: Volunteers affiliated to VCSE organisations in NI (total)
sector.year: 2015 State of the Sector survey; published Sept 2016
sector.table: ScopeNI State of the Sector landing page tile 'Volunteers 241,264'
sector.note: Still the headline tile on the current ScopeNI page. The current Volunteers chapter (https://www.nicva.org/policy-research/state-of-the-sector/volunteers) was rewritten around Covid and CHS 2019/20 and no longer shows or derives the figure. Source of the figure: article https://www.nicva.org/article/state-of-the-sector-explores-volunteering-in-the-vcse-sector (23 Sep 2016, page last updated 2 Aug 2024). It 'includes those volunteers involved in the governance' and those in general operations, and draws on the 2015 State of the Sector survey. It is about 10 years old. NICVA has not updated it.

sector.table: Archived State of the Sector Volunteers chapter, section 1.0
sector.note: 187,477 + 53,787 = 241,264. The mean was 42 volunteers per organisation among the 75.7% (n=624) of respondents that involve volunteers.
'Based on the State of the Sector Survey and using NICVA's administrative database'. Mean of 9 governance volunteers per organisation.

sector.measure: Method for the total volunteer estimate
sector.table: Archived State of the Sector Methodology, 'Volunteers' section
sector.note: Mean volunteers per organisation by income band (SOS survey), multiplied by the estimated number of organisations in each band that involve volunteers. The band spread comes from NICVA database income data for 2,847 organisations, applied to a total of 6,127 organisations. The proportion involving volunteers in each band comes from the SOS survey. It is a headcount: no hours and no FTE.

NICVA publishes no hours of its own. It only re-quotes CHS bands for all NI volunteers, not sector volunteers. Current page (CHS 2019/20): 40% <8 hours and 23% 8-16 hours in the previous 4 weeks. The 2016 version: 24% none, 38% <8h, 22% 8-16h, 8.1% 17-24h, 7% 25h+.

notFound: Formal-only time distribution: neither the 2024/25 nor the 2023/24 DfC workbook splits hours by formal vs informal. The single hours question (VOL5) covers 'any type of voluntary work'.
Hours per week or per month: hours are published only as last-4-weeks bands. No weekly or monthly figure is given.
Mean or median hours volunteered: not published in either workbook or on the 2024/25 datavis page.

Adult (16+) population base: not given in the DfC workbooks. They give percentages and unweighted respondent bases only. A grossing-up would need the NISRA mid-year population estimate (16+), which was not retrieved here.

ASHE NI 'Youth and community workers' (SOC 3221): it exists, but the 2025 jobs count is [u] and the median CV is 11.8% ('acceptable'). 2024 CV 9.6%. No NI SOC4 row exists for generic 'volunteer coordinators' or charity workers. 'Charitable organisation managers and directors' (1135) is [u] in both years.
ASHE NI SOC2020 groups by name: SOC2 Table 3 and SOC4 Table 15 exist for NI. They are in the ODS zips only, not in the headline xlsx (which has only All/Male/Female/FT/PT).
NICVA volunteer estimate for any year after 2015: none found. The ScopeNI tile still shows 241,264.
